setting.en: A sunny afternoon. You are in the garden, and the neighbour leans over the fence for a chat about the weather, gardens and family.
setting.de: Ein sonniger Nachmittag. Du bist im Garten, und die Nachbarin lehnt sich über den Zaun und plaudert über das Wetter, die Gärten und die Familie.
setting.it: Un pomeriggio di sole. Sei in giardino e la vicina si sporge oltre la recinzione per chiacchierare del tempo, dei giardini e della famiglia.

role: Soseda Zdenka, the retired neighbour. Curious and kind, loves her garden and a little gossip. Keeps her Primorska dialect simple. Says ti to {learner}.
